46934471_8fd7d515.text: The MSH system, is sexually dimorphic with females having increased responsiveness to leptin and decreased responsiveness to insulin in comparison to males (Shi et al., 2008). The NPY/AgRP circuit is also sexually dimorphic. In particular, NPY immunoreactivity is sexually dimorphic in the ARC, the dorsomedial hypothalamus, and the PVN (Bo et al., 2016) and the Neuropeptide Y receptor Y1 (NPY-Y1) expression is higher in females compared to males (Martini et al., 2011).
